evidence.title: From Atari to EVE Online: Building on 15 Years of AI Research in Games

summary: A comprehensive review traces a decade‑and‑a‑half of artificial intelligence advances in video games, beginning with early Atari experiments and culminating in sophisticated systems used in the MMO EVE Online. The analysis highlights key breakthroughs, ongoing challenges, and future directions for AI-driven gameplay across the industry.
title: 15 Years of Game AI Research: From Atari Classics to EVE Online
